messages:
deploy-bot: Release agent: attempting rollout 'canary/2026-03-21-7' to eu-west-1 at 17:05 UTC. Initiating preflight checks... :hourglass:
deploy-bot: ALERT: incident detected in eu-west-1 control plane — elevated 503 rate. Halting canary and placing release into cooldown. (reason: CP-503-spike).
Alex Chen: saw the dashboards — spike started ~17:03, correlated with a control-plane autoscaler flapping. good call to pause. :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: +1. propose a 30m cooldown, then a staggered retry with 10% traffic canary. also want to pin the model-serving version to v1.23.4 to avoid the new runtime path for this rollout.
Jon Rivera: agree on pin. I can prepare a rollback checklist if cooldown doesn't clear. will also note release notes change.
Morgan Lee: pinging infra — are there DB migration hooks in this canary? we should avoid any schema changes while CP unstable.
ops-bot: infra-check: no new migrations in this release. it's code + runtime tweak + model artifact swap. safe to delay attempt.
Alex Chen: Priya — can you update the release notes quick: call out cooldown and that we pinned runtime -> v1.23.4? I'll add a short blurb in the changelog.
Priya Patel: on it. drafting: "Canary paused due to control-plane instability in eu-west-1; runtime pinned to v1.23.4 for safety. No DB changes. Next attempt will be staggered 10% -> 30% -> 100% if stable."
Jon Rivera: rollback plan (short):
```
1) If next canary hits regressions, run `deploybot rollback canary/2026-03-21-7 --to-tag stable-2026-03-14`
2) Notify customers via status page if >5% error increase for 5m
3) Revert runtime pin only after postmortem and infra approval
```
Morgan Lee: infra watching CP autoscaler logs. also enabling a temporary tighter circuit-breaker on control-plane calls to reduce cascading errors.
deploy-bot: Actioned: hold placed by @Alex Chen (thread). cooldown scheduled until 17:35 UTC. Will surface next attempt options in 20m.
Alex Chen: schedule note — after 17:35 we'll try 10% canary in us/eu staggered windows (eu first). if CP still noisy, we abort and move to backfill schedule for tomorrow morning low-traffic window.
Priya Patel: added changelog entry and release notes comment. link: https://go/release/2026-03-21-7 (internal).
Jon Rivera: I'll own the rollback runbook and the incident blurb for postmortem. tagging @Morgan for infra signoff.
Morgan Lee: +1, will post infra status updates here in ~5–10m. watching logs now.
ops-bot: Reminder: when rescheduling, use `deploybot schedule --window=\"low-traffic\" --region=eu-west-1 --stagger=10,30,100` to create the new slot.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. will reconvene on this thread once infra gives all-clear or if we need to shift to rollback. :ok_hand:
